snippet.title: ¿Podría Diosdado ser CONDENADO POR EEUU? Hombre que AMENAZÓ DE MUERTE A MARCO RUBIO fue sentenciado
snippet.description:
El programa Club de Prensa de NTN24 repasa y analiza con voces expertas la condena a un hombre en Miami por amenazar de muerte en redes sociales al secretario de Estado de Estados Unidos, Marco Rubio, y las posibilidades de que Diosdado Cabello, número dos del régimen, reciba una sentencia por motivos similares. 

Cabello, cabe resaltar, señaló a Rubio de "delincuente" y aseveró que, supuestamente, Venezuela tenía "elementos para solicitar un código rojo" contra el entones senador "por participar abiertamente en la conspiración para asesinar un presidente".

Es importante mencionar que el ministro de Interior del régimen, actualmente a cargo de Delcy Rodríguez, tiene vigente un afiche activo en la página del Departamento de Estado: 25 millones de dólares es la recompensa que ofrece Estados Unidos por información que dé con la captura de Cabello.

Rubio señaló recientemente al respecto que "la política de Estados Unidos en ese sentido no ha cambiado", una postura que ha elevado las preguntas acerca de por qué el Gobierno de Donald Trump no ha tomado la decisión de capturarlo.

snippet.description:
Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth awarded a medal on Thursday to the very soldier who admonished his party during a Veterans Day ceremony at Arlington National Cemetery.

Hegseth presented Spc. Thomas Iglesias with the Joint Service Commendation Medal for his conduct at the Tomb of the Unknown Soldier.

On Wednesday, someone in Hegseth’s group was heard laughing as they walked away after taking photos at the site.

A Pentagon spokesperson said Iglesias had “correctly and respectfully reminded everyone to maintain decorum.”

snippet.title: ۲۴ با فرداد فرحزاد: سفر رئیس موساد به آمریکا
snippet.description:
سفر رئیس موساد به واشینگتن در میانه گمانه‌زنی‌ها درباره احتمال حمله دوباره اسرائیل به جمهوری اسلامی، نگرانی‌ها از آغاز دور تازه‌ای از درگیری‌های نظامی در منطقه را افزایش داده است. همزمان با رایزنی‌های امنیتی اسرائیل و آمریکا، دولت ترامپ فشارهای اقتصادی بر تهران را ادامه می‌دهد و وزیر خزانه‌داری آمریکا از زمستانی سخت برای جمهوری اسلامی خبر داده است.

در برنامه امشب «۲۴ با فرداد فرحزاد»، آخرین تحولات مربوط به احتمال رویارویی دوباره ایران و اسرائیل، سیاست‌های دولت ترامپ در قبال جمهوری اسلامی، تحریم‌های نفتی و محدودیت‌های دریایی، و آینده مذاکرات هسته‌ای را بررسی می‌کنیم.

همچنین به گزارش آژانس بین‌المللی انرژی اتمی درباره فعالیت‌های هسته‌ای ایران و مخالفت تهران با ازسرگیری بازرسی‌ها در شرایط جنگی می‌پردازیم.

در بخش دیگری از برنامه، اختلال گسترده در خدمات مایکروسافت و پیامدهای آن برای میلیون‌ها کاربر در سراسر جهان را بررسی می‌کنیم.

با حضور کارشناسان و تحلیلگران، از جمله جمشید برزگر، روزنامه‌نگار و تحلیلگر سیاسی.

snippet.title: Tropas de Bukele usam cães-robôs armados em operação no Haiti
snippet.description:
O presidente de El Salvador, Nayib Bukele, afirmou que tropas salvadorenhas e haitianas assumiram o controle do estádio Sylvio Cator, no Haiti, chegando a encontrar crânios humanos no local.

Em um post na rede social X, Bukele compartilhou um vídeo que seria da operação militar.

O post foi feito dias depois de o presidente compartilhar outro vídeo que, segundo ele, mostrava ataques à casa de Lanmò San Jou, líder da gangue haitiana 400 Mawozo, e à sede do grupo.

Um pequeno contingente de tropas salvadorenhas está no Haiti desde janeiro de 2025, como parte de uma força multinacional enviada para conter a violência das gangues.

Em outubro desde ano, Bukele enviou mais 2 mil soldados para resgatar quatro salvadorenhos desaparecidos desde que foram emboscados em 18 de outubro. Veja mais no vídeo.

Cyclone Alert: Heavy Rain Warning for Odisha from November 18 | IMD Issues Yellow & Orange Alerts

Odisha is likely to witness heavy rainfall due to the approaching cyclone over the Bay of Bengal. The Regional Meteorological Centre has issued an advance weather warning, predicting increased rainfall across the state from November 18, with southern and northern coastal Odisha likely to experience significant weather activity.

According to the weather department, heavy rainfall of 7 to 11 cm is possible on November 18. Yellow alerts have been issued for Ganjam, Gajapati, Puri and Khordha districts. For November 19, orange alerts have been issued for Kandhamal, Rayagada, Kendrapara, Jagatsinghpur, Khordha, Cuttack, Nayagarh, Koraput and Malkangiri. Several districts are also likely to remain under yellow and orange alerts on November 20.

The Meteorological Centre has also advised fishermen not to venture into the sea from November 17 to November 20. Those already at sea have been advised to return by November 15. Wind speeds over the sea are currently reaching 45 to 55 kmph.

With the approaching cyclone likely to influence Odisha's weather, authorities have urged people to remain alert and follow official weather advisories.

Watch this report for the latest cyclone updates, district-wise rainfall warnings and Odisha weather alerts.

snippet.title: VisionQuest Explained: The Family Reunion That Breaks In Doomsday 🤖
snippet.description:
VisionQuest is the direct continuation of WandaVision (2021) and Agatha All Along (2024). Paul Bettany returns as Vision in his first solo MCU series. The show ended with the Maximoff-Vision family reunited and Wanda's shocking resurrection at the hands of Doctor Doom. Here is the entire 8-episode series in a fast recap.

The Setup

5 years after the events of Westview. White Vision has spent 5 years trying to understand what the original Vision's memories mean. He has built a mind palace with AI programs: JARVIS (James D'Arcy), FRIDAY (Orla Brady), EDITH (Emily Hampshire), and Ultron (James Spader) locked inside.

Vision works undercover as a bar back in Edinburgh. He has no emotional connection to anything.

Episodes 1-2: The Rescue

A bounty hunter named Paladin (Todd Stashwick) attacks the pub. Fiona (Vision's coworker) is killed. Ultron admits he leaked Vision's location out of boredom.

Paladin has captured Thomas Shepherd (Ruaridh Mollica). Thomas is the body Billy Maximoff placed Tommy Maximoff's soul into at the end of Agatha All Along.

Vision breaks into Saint Mabyn's psychiatric facility to rescue Thomas. Paladin ambushes him with adamantium bullets. Vision escapes with Tommy in a beat-up car.

Episodes 3-4: Jocasta

A shadowy killer called the Butcherbird is hunting scientists from Markridge Biotech. She is revealed as Jocasta (T'Nia Miller), the consciousness of Dr. Josephine Carrington transferred into a Vibranium android body.

She quotes Ultron: "Peace in our time." She is hunting the scientists who betrayed her.

Episodes 5-6: Raza Returns
